Civil Engineering (B.Tech. - 4yrs)

Programme Outcomes (POs)
1 Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of basic science, fundamental engineering and civil engineering to the solution of complex engineering problems in the domain of civil engineering.
2 Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of basic science, fundamental engineering and subjects of the domain of civil engineering.
3 Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and system components or processes for the domain of civil engineering that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
4 Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions related to the domain of civil engineering.
5 Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modelling to complex activities with an understanding of the limitations related to the domain of civil engineering.
6 The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
7 Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions related to the domain of civil engineering in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of and need for sustainable development.
8 Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
9 Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
11 Project management and finance: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
12 Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.
Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)
1 To produce graduates with fundamentals in sciences and engineering.
2 To train graduates with technical competence in solving real-life civil engineering problems.
3 To encourage life-long learning, adherence to professional ethics, and codes of practice.
4 To enable graduates to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams for sustainable development, and fulfilling organizational goals.
5 To encourage innovative thinking, leadership, and entrepreneurship in civil engineering.
Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs)
1 Technical knowledge: acquire the technical knowledge related to civil engineering along with the basic sciences and engineering to critically analyze and solve complex problems to carry out higher studies, research as well as developmental work in the domain of civil engineering.
2 Modern engineering skill: select and apply modern engineering software tools to analyze real-life engineering problems and develop applications in the domain of civil engineering.
3 Communication, team work, ethics and continuous learning: attain skills for communicating effectively in both oral and written forms, working in a team, and developing the ability for taking up time-bound responsibilities with professional ethics and recognize the importance of continuous learning.
